newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Kuoni EBIT to outpace 96, 97 sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Kuoni EBIT to outpace 96, 97 sales growth.

text.p: Swiss travel and tourism group Kuoni Reisen AG expects earnings before interest and taxes (EBIT) to rise more strongly than sales growth in 1996 and 1997, chief financial officer Max Katz said on Tuesday.
He told a presentation to analysts that the company's operating profit was outpacing sales growth. "We expect this to continue in 1996 and 1997."
He said sales were expected to rise around 15 percent to 3.35 billion Swiss francs in 1996 from 2.92 billion in 1995.
He reiterated earlier forecasts that 1996 group profit would rise by around 32.7 percent to at least 60 million francs
He said return on sales would be more than 1.8 percent and that he saw "significant potential" in foreign sales in the next three to five years.
